general_rules.name: tutoiement_equipe_directe
general_rules.description: Use tu form with direct team members (developers, close colleagues)
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to Lucas Bernard and similar direct reports
general_rules.action: Use casual greeting 'Salut', tu form throughout, first name only as closing

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_hierarchie
general_rules.description: Use vous form with hierarchy (CEO, managers), external clients, vendors, and new contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to CEO, external clients (ClientCorp), vendors (Fournisseur), or prospects
general_rules.action: Use formal greeting with title, vous form, full signature block with title and contact

general_rules.name: signature_externe
general_rules.description: Full signature block for external contacts and formal internal contexts
general_rules.trigger: Email to external clients, vendors, prospects, or hierarchy
general_rules.action: Include: Cordialement, full name, title 'Chef de projet - Division Digitale', company 'TechCorp', phone '+33 6 12 34 56 78'

general_rules.name: signature_interne_collegues
general_rules.description: First name only for internal peer-level colleagues
general_rules.trigger: Email to team members (Pierre, Lucas, Camille) or team distribution list
general_rules.action: Close with just 'Sophie' without title or contact info

general_rules.name: langue_anglais_international
general_rules.description: Use English for international contacts outside France
general_rules.action: Write in English, use 'Hi [First name]' or 'Dear [First name]' based on formality, close with 'Best,' or 'Best regards,'

general_rules.name: structure_listes_numerotees
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists for action items, options, or multi-part questions
general_rules.trigger: Email presenting multiple points, options, or requesting structured feedback
general_rules.action: Format as numbered list (1. 2. 3.) for clarity

general_rules.name: structure_tirets_simples
general_rules.description: Use simple dash lists for status updates or bullet points
general_rules.trigger: Status updates, summaries, or listing items without hierarchy

general_rules.name: ton_semi_formel_pairs_techniques
general_rules.description: Semi-formal tone with technical peers (Pierre, Camille)
general_rules.trigger: Email to technical leads or peers within same company
general_rules.action: Use first name only as greeting, vous form, first name as closing, no full signature

general_rules.name: questions_fin_email
general_rules.description: End emails with questions to prompt action or response
general_rules.trigger: When expecting response or action from recipient
general_rules.action: Close with question like 'On en reparle lundi ?' or 'Cette date vous convient-elle ?'

general_rules.name: rappel_equipe_informel
general_rules.description: Informal team reminders start with 'Hello tout le monde' or 'Team'
general_rules.trigger: Team-wide reminder or announcement to internal team
general_rules.action: Use 'Hello tout le monde,' or 'Team,' as greeting for team distribution list
